-- Заголовок local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", mainFrame) title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0) title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0) title.BackgroundTransparency = 1 title.Font = Enum.Font.Code title.Text = "Fake Admin 1.0  by pipam938" title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) title.TextSize = 14

local close = Instance.new("TextButton", mainFrame) close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0) close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 0) close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 0, 0) close.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) close.Text = "X" close.Font = Enum.Font.Code close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) close.TextSize = 14

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() screenGui:Destroy() end)

-- Кнопка свернуть local minimize = Instance.new("TextButton", mainFrame) minimize.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0) minimize.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 0) minimize.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 0) minimize.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) minimize.Text = "-" minimize.Font = Enum.Font.Code minimize.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) minimize.TextSize = 14

-- Контейнер для вкладок local tabContainer = Instance.new("Frame", screenGui) tabContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 500) tabContainer.Position = mainFrame.Position + UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30) tabContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15) tabContainer.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) tabContainer.Visible = true

minimize.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() tabContainer.Visible = not tabContainer.Visible end)

-- Универсальная функция кнопки local function createButton(text, y, parent, callback) local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", parent) btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 22) btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, y) btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25) btn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code btn.Text = text btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) btn.TextSize = 12 btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback) return btn end

-- === Вкладка Players === local playersButton = createButton("Players", 5, tabContainer, function() for _, child in ipairs(tabContainer:GetChildren()) do if child.Name == "playersPanel" then child.Visible = not child.Visible return end end

local panel = Instance.new("Frame", tabContainer)
panel.Name = "playersPanel"
panel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 150)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local targetBox = createLabeledField(panel, "Target Player", 0)

local function addPlayerAction(text, y, action)
    createButton(text, y, panel, function()
        local name = targetBox.Text:lower()
        for _, plr in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr.Name:lower():find(name) then
                action(plr)
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- === Вкладка Server === local serverButton = createButton("Server", 35, tabContainer, function() for _, child in ipairs(tabContainer:GetChildren()) do if child.Name == "serverPanel" then child.Visible = not child.Visible return end end

local panel = Instance.new("Frame", tabContainer)
panel.Name = "serverPanel"
panel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 150)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 60)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local function addServerAction(text, y, action)
    createButton(text, y, panel, function()
        for _, plr in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
            action(plr)
        end
    end)
end

local y = 5

y = y + 25
